description.value: Euro Food Tri-City is a specialty European grocery and deli in Coquitlam, stocking an extensive range of Eastern European imports including cured meats, aged cheeses, herring, pierogies, pelmeni, preserves, and a vast confectionery selection from Russia, Ukraine, Poland, and beyond. In-store, freshly made hot soups, salads, pastries, and coffee are available daily. The shop also operates as an official Meest parcel agency for shipments to Eastern Europe.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Euro Food Tri-City is a real, open European grocery and deli store at 555 North Road in Coquitlam, open seven days a week, with an extensive product catalogue (492+ items). Basic groceries are confirmed by the broad product categories listed; hot food is confirmed by the About page stating 'you can always enjoy a hot daily soup, salads, cup of tea or coffee, freshly backed European pastry.' No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site. The OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the website consistently places the store in Coquitlam, which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the website consistently places the store at 555 North Road, Coquitlam — the OSM node may be mis-attributed to the wrong municipality.
OSM name 'Euro Food Tri City' differs slightly from the website's rendering 'Eurofood Tri-city'; no normalization applied per rules.
No phone number present in OSM tags or anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating European grocery and deli with a full product catalogue and confirmed hot food; useful to touring cyclists seeking provisions or a hot meal stop near Lougheed Town Centre.
enrichment_extras.notes: Address '555 North Road, Coquitlam, BC' sourced from the Letter from the Owners page; no postal code was provided on the website.
